steps.hardClue: Turn on the power, then switch it back off.
steps.clue: Turn on the power, then switch it back off when Maxis instructs you.

steps.hardClue: Wait for lightning, then wait for the electric enemy to appear.
steps.clue: Wait for lightning above the pylon, then wait for the Avogadro to appear.

steps.hardClue: Place two portable devices beneath the pylon and lure the electric enemy underneath it.
steps.clue: Place two Turbines beneath the pylon and lure the Avogadro underneath it.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the electrical enemy beneath the pylon with a tactical grenade.
steps.clue: Defeat the Avogadro beneath the pylon with an EMP Grenade.

steps.hardClue: Place two portable devices beneath separate streetlights to activate the pylon.
steps.clue: Place two Turbines beneath two streetlights to activate the pylon.
